title: init generator
description: Sets up the release workflow: creates a tools project with the publish target, registers the plugin, and creates .github/workflows/release.yml.

projectName.description: Name of the tools project to create or update. Default: tools.

packageName.description: npm package name to publish. Default: derived from the root package.json name.

packagePath.description: Path to the package directory containing package.json. Default: packages/cli.

branch.description: Branch to push the bump commit to. Default: main.
